diagnosis: The adapter incorrectly treated parallel_tool_calls=false as a guarantee of exactly one Tool call. DeepSeek repeatedly returned two valid read proposals in one response. No returned call was executed and no trial receipt was created.
correction: Accept one or more Tool calls from one Provider response. Validate every call against the exact offered catalog. A response containing submit is valid only when submit is the sole call. Otherwise search/read calls are executed sequentially in returned order, with one Tool result per call id. Physical observation ceilings remain global per trial; calls beyond the ceiling receive a budget notice rather than being executed.
scientificDisposition: The failed pre-sample attempt is apparatus evidence only and is excluded from HP3 outcome statistics.
